answer_2.quote: The evaluation metric is the Spearman correlation between the similarity scores predicted by the model and the scores annotated by humans. In addition, to evaluate retrieval performance, we assess the model on MS MARCO, NFCorpus, and SCIDOCS using nDCG@10 as the evaluation metric.
